messages.text:
Hi Martin,

Starting November 1, EU shipments missing required product identifiers will be held at customs. EU customs brokers are legally liable for these shipments, and they will not clear them without complete data.

Held shipments create costs, and those costs will be billed to your account:

  *   Storage fees while your shipment sits at customs or with the carrier

  *   Additional handling and manual processing fees

  *   Return shipping fees if you choose to have the package sent back

If a held shipment isn’t resolved or returned, it may be abandoned.

Under the FlavorCloud Terms And Conditions<····>, costs caused by incomplete or incorrect shipment information are the merchant’s responsibility. For shipments placed on or after November 1, we will bill these costs back to your account automatically.

Carriers may also refuse to create labels for shipments missing this data. When that happens, your order may move to a higher-cost shipping option or be unable to ship at all.

You have 12 days to avoid these costs.

Next steps:

  1.  Follow our setup guide<····> to create the required fields in your ecommerce platform.

  2.  Request manufacturer references from your suppliers today. This step takes the longest.

  3.  Fill in your top-selling EU products first.

Questions? Reach out to (email hidden)<mailto:(email hidden)>.

The F. Team

Note: If you are already working with FlavorCloud on updating your catalog please continue to do so. You do not need to take any additional action.
